ns2:course.label: Industrial Design VI
ns2:course.description: Capstone project integrating all aspects of the design process from concept through final design, documentation and presentation; reconciliation of user centered constraints such as socio-economic, environmental-sustainability, manufacturability, health and safety and ethical. Standard approach that of an entry level industrial design professional. Prerequisite: ARTD 401.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class Materials Fee of $40 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
